connectionReference.description: Connects to SharePoint Online for logging and documenting incoming email records

sharePointListSchema.description: Stores a record of every incoming email processed by the Copilot Email Agent

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Email subject line (maps to the default SharePoint Title column)

columns.name: ReceivedDateTime
columns.description: Date and time the email was received

columns.name: BodyPreview
columns.description: First 500 characters of the email body

columns.name: ConversationId
columns.description: Conversation thread ID for grouping related emails

columns.name: AutoReplySent
columns.description: Whether an auto-reply was sent for this email

columns.name: AutoReplySentDateTime
columns.description: Date and time the auto-reply was sent

columns.name: RuleApplied
columns.description: Name of the matching email rule applied

columns.name: Category
columns.description: Category tag assigned by the matching rule

columns.name: FlaggedForFollowUp
columns.description: Whether this email was flagged for follow-up

setupInstructions: 1. Go to your SharePoint site and create a new list named 'EmailLog'
2. Add all columns listed in the sharePointListSchema above
3. In Copilot Studio, go to Settings > Connections
5. Sign in and grant access to the SharePoint site
7. Update the siteUrl field in this file with your SharePoint site URL
8. Update sharePointSiteUrl in settings.json under emailSettings.documentation
